    INNER JOIN skills AS s1 ON s0."SkillId" = s1.guid
) AS s2 ON s.guid = s2."SeekerId"
LEFT JOIN educations AS e ON s.guid = e."SeekerId"
LEFT JOIN experiences AS e0 ON s.guid = e0."SeekerId"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT j.guid, j."AppliedOn", j."IsDeleted", j."JobPostId", j."SeekerId", j."Status", j0.guid AS guid0, j0."Description", j0."EmploymentPosition", j0."EmploymentType", j0."IsDeleted" AS "IsDeleted0", j0."LastDate", j0."Maxsalary", j0."Minsalary", j0."PostedDate", j0."RecruiterID", j0."Title", r.guid AS guid1, r."CompanyId", r."Designation", r."FirstName", r."IsDeleted" AS "IsDeleted1", r."LastName", r."PhoneNumber", r."UserId", c.guid AS guid2, c."CompanyName", c."Description" AS "Description0", c."IndustryTypeId", c."IsDeleted" AS "IsDeleted2", c."WebsiteUrl"
    FROM "jobApplications" AS j
    INNER JOIN "jobPosts" AS j0 ON j."JobPostId" = j0.guid
    INNER JOIN recruiters AS r ON j0."RecruiterID" = r.guid
    INNER JOIN companies AS c ON r."CompanyId" = c.guid
) AS s3 ON s.guid = s3."SeekerId"
WHERE NOT (s."IsDeleted")
ORDER BY s.guid, s2.guid, s2.guid0, e.guid, e0."Guid", s3.guid, s3.guid0, s3.guid1
